# Beauty by Alaena

> Hair and makeup artist based in Rocklin and Roseville, Placer County, California. Alaena travels to clients for weddings, proms, quinceañeras, and events, and she travels nationwide for destination weddings.

Alaena comes to you on the event day. Trials are held at her home studio in Rocklin. Locally she serves Rocklin, Roseville, Granite Bay, Lincoln, Loomis, Auburn, Folsom, El Dorado Hills, and Sacramento. She also travels for destination weddings, including Lake Tahoe bridal hair and makeup, Napa and Sonoma weddings, and celebrations anywhere in the United States. Destination travel fees are quoted per event.

Email: beautybyalaena@gmail.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_beautybyalaena

## Places

Local on-location guides. Travel within 30 miles of the Rocklin studio is included, and travel beyond that is $2 per mile, round trip. Lake Tahoe, Napa, and Sonoma are destination weddings; travel for those is quoted per event and they are not added to the local area served.
